cats.name: 阿比西尼亚
facts: One of the oldest cat breeds ever.
Every hair has colorful stripes on it.
Stays playful like a kitten forever.

cats.name: 美短
facts: Sailed to America with early settlers.
Its hard coat keeps out rain and dirt.
A calm, quiet friend who loves kids.

cats.name: 孟加拉豹猫
facts: Looks like a tiny wild leopard.
Many Bengals love playing in water.
Its coat can sparkle with golden glitter.

cats.name: 伯曼猫
facts: Called the Sacred Cat of Burma.
Always wears four white mitten paws.
Has deep blue eyes and silky fur.

cats.name: 英短
facts: Its fur feels like thick velvet.
Famous for its round, smiling face.
Takes up to five years to grow up.

cats.name: 德文卷毛猫
facts: Has huge ears like a bat.
Its curly coat feels like lamb's wool.
First found in England in 1960.

cats.name: 缅因猫
facts: One of the biggest house cats ever.
Has furry feet like built-in snowshoes.
Acts like a dog and plays fetch.

cats.name: 挪威森林猫
facts: Built to survive cold Norwegian winters.
Its fluffy coat keeps out rain and snow.
An amazing climber who loves tall trees.

cats.name: 波斯猫
facts: The world's most popular fancy cat.
Has a flat face and big round eyes.
Needs brushing every single day.

cats.name: 布偶猫
facts: Goes limp like a rag doll when held.
Always has beautiful blue eyes.
Gentle with children, dogs, and other pets.

cats.name: 俄罗斯蓝猫
facts: Its gray coat shimmers with silver tips.
Born with yellow eyes that turn green.
Shy with strangers but loves its family.

cats.name: 苏格兰折耳猫
facts: Its ears fold down like a hat.
Looks a little bit like an owl.
First found on a Scottish farm in 1961.

cats.name: 暹罗
facts: Loves to talk to you all day.
Its dark ears, paws, and tail stand out.
Can live up to twenty years.

cats.name: 西伯利亚猫
facts: Comes from the snowy forests of Russia.
Has a triple coat that repels water.
Jumps and climbs like an athlete.

cats.name: 斯芬克斯猫
facts: A cat with no fur at all.
Its skin feels warm like soft suede.
Needs a bath every week.
